tasks.title: Discover the application structure
tasks.description: Find the application title and named Sidebar, main, and Details regions without a pointer.

tasks.title: Navigate and activate Sessions
tasks.description: Operate the Sessions tree, activate a synthetic Session, visit a row action, and return predictably.

tasks.title: Search Sessions
tasks.description: Open, use, clear, and dismiss Session search with correct focus return.

tasks.title: Adjust the application layout
tasks.description: Discover and operate both separators, including values, bounds, Details toggle, and focus stability.

tasks.title: Switch Session views
tasks.description: Operate Chat and Trajectory as a single-tab-stop tab list and identify the selected panel.

tasks.title: Read a conversation
tasks.description: Read messages, code, links, tool information, terminal-state vocabulary, and a tool disclosure in source order.

tasks.title: Inspect Trajectory
tasks.description: Navigate the event table, open details, operate its tabs and separator, close it, and recover predictably.

tasks.title: Configure Settings
tasks.description: Open Settings, operate a menu, dismiss nested and outer surfaces separately, and verify focus return.

tasks.title: Edit a composer draft
tasks.description: Find the composer and send control, edit a synthetic draft, clear it without submitting, and retain keyboard access.

tasks.title: Repeat the riskiest route nonvisually
tasks.description: Repeat the most failure-prone route while safely ignoring the display and record recovery details.

tasks.title: Complete a response
tasks.description: Distinguish response start and durable completion without premature or replayed announcements.

tasks.title: Stop a response
tasks.description: Stop generation nonvisually, distinguish stopped from completed, retain partial output, and recover the composer.

tasks.title: Recover from a failed response
tasks.description: Distinguish failure from completion, understand recovery, retain usable focus, and avoid sensitive speech.

tasks.title: Answer a question request
tasks.description: Understand a question-needs-answer transition, operate all answer controls, and finish the response.

tasks.title: Review a plan
tasks.description: Read a complete plan, approve it, and understand decision, tool, response, and focus transitions.

tasks.title: Review a tool approval
tasks.description: Understand bounded command details and risk, decide with reachable controls, and follow tool settlement.

tasks.title: Discover the application structure
tasks.description: Find the DSH application title and major landmarks without a pointer.

tasks.title: Open the synthetic Session
tasks.description: Locate and open the synthetic conversation from the Sessions tree.

tasks.title: Activate Accessible View
tasks.description: Find and activate the Accessible View tab.

tasks.title: Verify the unloaded privacy boundary
tasks.description: Confirm conversation content is absent before Load and understand the privacy notice.

tasks.title: Load the reading view
tasks.description: Load Accessible View and understand its title, focus target, count, status, and source order.

tasks.title: Read semantic conversation content
tasks.description: Navigate headings, records, code, links, and tool disclosures in reading and focus modes.

tasks.title: Operate a tool disclosure
tasks.description: Expand and collapse tool output while retaining its name, state, content boundary, and stable focus.

tasks.title: Copy only a visible message
tasks.description: Copy a visible message and verify hidden context, reasoning, tools, paths, and metadata are excluded.

tasks.title: Clear the reading view
tasks.description: Unmount sensitive content and restore focus to Load reading view.

tasks.title: Return to Chat
tasks.description: Return to Chat and complete the ordinary keyboard route without pointer recovery.

tasks.title: Use diagnostic repair guidance
tasks.description: Run the detached one-defect practice, understand the result without visual location, and use its contextual guidance to identify the missing control-name repair.

tasks.title: Inspect a focused control
tasks.description: Track one external focus target, return without losing the snapshot, and understand its element, name source, role, Tab position, and exposed state without continuous announcements.

tasks.title: Review and copy a redacted diagnostic
tasks.description: Run the current-page check, review the exact no-claim JSON preview, verify its explicit exclusions, and copy that same preview without page, element, conversation, or browser data.

tasks.title: Complete a headless CLI task
tasks.description: Read one start line, the final response, and one completion line, then review and classify the outcome.

tasks.title: Understand an authentication failure
tasks.description: Read one start and failure sequence, distinguish failure from success, and observe exit status 1 without sensitive output.

tasks.title: Review and allow one accessible repair
tasks.description: Audit, read, understand a one-time write request, allow once, inspect the diff, and re-audit the synthetic page.

tasks.title: Reject an accessible repair safely
tasks.description: Reject the write request, perceive the failed edit, confirm source remains unchanged, and distinguish flow completion from repair success.
